title: Install GlusterFS on Debian 12 (Bookworm) (stable)
summary: A step-by-step install tutorial for Debian 12 (Bookworm). Use the stable Eliware repository, verify package and service state at every checkpoint, and replace angle-bracket placeholders with values from your environment.

steps.title: Prepare the host
steps.text: Update APT and install tools for a signed external repository.
commands: sudo apt install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg

steps.title: Install the Eliware key
steps.text: Use a dedicated keyring and a signed-by source entry.
steps.verify: The keyring is readable by APT.

steps.title: Configure the repository
steps.text: Use the stable channel for Debian 12 (Bookworm) and verify the suite and architecture.
steps.verify: The Eliware candidate is visible and no unsigned source is used.

steps.title: Install and start GlusterFS
steps.text: Install the server and client packages, then enable glusterd.
steps.verify: The daemon is active and the expected version is installed.

steps.title: Validate the node
steps.text: Check identity, time, storage mounts, and firewall policy. Bricks must use node-local storage with extended attributes.
commands: sudo firewall-cmd --list-all 2>/dev/null || sudo ufw status verbose
steps.verify: Name resolution, time, storage, and firewall policy are intentional.

steps.title: Build the trusted pool
steps.text: From one trusted node, probe each new node and verify the pool.

steps.title: Create and test a replica-3 volume
steps.text: Prepare one local brick directory on every node, create and start the volume, then test a client mount.
steps.verify: The volume is Started and the test file is visible through the mount.
